meta.name: google-search-serp
meta.description: Extracts Google Search results page (SERP) data including organic results, paid ads, related searches, People Also Ask questions, AI Overview text, and total result count from google.com. Use when user mentions Google search results, SERP scraping, google search data, search engine results page, organic rankings, keyword SERP, Google SERP extraction, scrape Google search, Google search API alternative, SEO ranking data, paid search ads, PPC ads on Google, Google search monitoring, keyword research, search results export, check Google rankings, what shows up on Google, search engine scraper, google results checker.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提取谷歌搜索结果页的各类数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要获取谷歌搜索结果用于SEO或广告分析
copy.tagline_en: Extract various data from Google search results pages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract Google search results for SEO or ad analysis

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能自动提取 Google 搜索结果页上的所有可见信息，包括自然结果、付费广告、相关搜索、People Also Ask 问题和 AI 概览，并返回结构化数据。
howto.when: 当你提到 Google 搜索结果、SERP 抓取、SEO 排名数据、付费广告或关键词研究等话题时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下“机器学习”的 Google 搜索结果。
say.note: Claude 会提取该关键词的 SERP 数据。

say.text: 提取“best coffee maker”的前 20 条自然结果。
say.note: Claude 会按指定数量提取有机结果。

say.text: 看看“digital marketing”这个关键词有哪些付费广告。
say.note: Claude 会返回 paidResults 数组。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can automatically extract all visible information from Google search results pages, including organic results, paid ads, related searches, People Also Ask questions, and AI Overview, returning structured data.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention Google search results, SERP scraping, SEO ranking data, paid ads, or keyword research.

say_en.text: Get me Google search results for 'machine learning'.
say_en.note: Claude will extract SERP data for that keyword.

say_en.text: Extract the top 20 organic results for 'best coffee maker'.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch the specified number of organic results.

say_en.text: Show me paid ads for 'digital marketing'.
say_en.note: Claude will return the paidResults array.
